sections.voiceover: El Clasico is the intense rivalry between FC Barcelona and Real Madrid, spanning 264 official meetings.
But who won their first LALIGA match on February 17, 1929, at Les Corts?
The Merengues flipped the script, securing a 2-1 victory against FC Barcelona that day.
Real Madrid claimed that first LALIGA meeting with 2 goals against 1. Founders Joan Gamper and the Padrós brothers built these clubs for 264 official meetings.
Today, those 264 official meetings define the legacy of these two legendary football clubs.
